title: Validate your target and budget
description: Confirm degree, destination preferences and the maximum annual budget with your sponsor.

title: Build your IELTS preparation plan
description: Take a diagnostic test, set a 7.0 target and create a six-week weekly study schedule.

title: Prepare academic documents
description: Collect your transcript, provisional certificate, grading scale and course descriptions.

title: Finalize a five-program shortlist
description: Choose a balanced shortlist containing safe, target and ambitious options.

title: Draft your statement of purpose
description: Connect your academic preparation, projects and career direction to each target program.

title: Complete funding and sponsor plan
description: Document available funds, scholarship targets and the financial evidence timeline.
